records.issue_text: EmbeddableHost lacks case-insensitive uniqueness enforcement on host, allowing duplicate hosts with conflicting categories and arbitrary lookup results
records.rationale: The EmbeddableHost model in app/models/embeddable_host.rb only validates format with validates_format_of :host but has no uniqueness validation. The host_allowed? method uses `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` which does case-insensitive lookup, but without a uniqueness constraint, duplicate hosts (even with different cases) can be inserted. This could lead to conflicting category assignments
